# Compound Bay Marketplace

> A marketplace for comparing approved peptide sellers and completing a single, tracked checkout.

## Primary pages

- [Marketplace](https://market.peptide.chat/): Search products, compare sellers, and manage checkout.
- [PepChat](https://peptide.chat/): Sign in or create the PepChat identity used by marketplace checkout.
